rankedCandidates.title: Rent (pay for time-limited use)
rankedCandidates.description: A type of 'Buy' activity where one pays for the temporary, time-limited use of a resource, rather than for its permanent ownership. This involves acquiring the right to use something for a specific period, after which the right expires. The resource being rented can be a physical object (e.g., a car or apartment), information (e.g., a streaming movie), or a service. The agreement itself can also vary, from a formal 'Lease' for property and equipment to 'Hire' for a person's labor or services. This category is for the act of *paying to use* a resource. It is the counterpart to activities like 'Lease out' or 'Rent out', where one receives payment for providing temporary use of a resource.
